Whole-ROM classification is 262157 B evidence-backed + 3 B Manual fallback. Spot-checked headers against code in banks 9, 11-15 (random sample of 7 plus every edited routine): no other contradictions found. Remaining raw RAM operands: only Reset's eight page-clear stores (commented). Remaining numeric $8000/$8001/$8020/$BE00/$A980/$9CF0 operands are pair-relative switched-bank tables read from fixed-bank code (commented). Accepted limitations: 253 short helpers/secondary entries (<24 code bytes) rely on descriptive names; object-type identities, boss behaviours A-F, bonus prize rules, special-object meaning, generic data bank formats and write-only variables remain unresolved and are recorded in uncertainties.md with tentative wording.
